crossRefs.note: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you…
Behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, “What ails the people that they weep?” They told…
The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.
The king said to her, “What is your problem?” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him…
What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Micah
people.line: A man from Ephraim who set up idolatrous worship.

translations.web: As they called to the children of Dan, they turned their faces, and said to Micah, “What ails you, that you come with such a company?”
translations.bsb: When they called out after them, the Danites turned to face them and said to Micah, “What is the matter with you that you have called out such a company?”
translations.kjv: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?
translations.asv: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?
